reference.question: Construct the perpendicular bisector of segment $AB$ with a straightedge and compass. It intersects $AB$ at $M$. If $AB=7.6\text{ cm}$, what is the length of $AM$? (Unit: cm)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use the midpoint

$M$ is the midpoint of $AB$, so $AM=7.6\div 2=3.8$.
